title: Kubernetes Node Not Ready
steps: Identify the affected node: kubectl get nodes.
Check node conditions: kubectl describe node <node-name>.
Inspect kubelet logs: journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 on the node.
Check disk pressure and memory pressure conditions.
If node is unrecoverable, cordon and drain: kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data.
Escalate to #infra-team if multiple nodes are affected.

title: CDN Cache Miss Rate Spike
steps: Check CDN dashboard for cache hit ratio drop.
Verify origin server health and response times.
Check if a recent deployment invalidated the cache.
Review cache-control headers on affected endpoints.
If origin is overloaded, scale up origin servers.
Escalate to #platform-eng if miss rate stays above 40% for 15 minutes.
